question: Which country will host the 2024 Summer Olympic Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __France__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The host city of the 2024 Summer Olympics is Paris, France.
 
• The Motto is Made for Sharing.
 
• Skateboarding, sport climbing, surfing, and breaking have been confirmed as the additional sports proposed for inclusion at the Paris Olympic Games in 2024.
 
• Los Angeles, California, United States will host the 2028 Summer Olympics.
